title: Report-only not structurally enforced: Bash patterns permit writes
description: allowed-tools pre-approves Bash(git diff:*) and Bash(rg:*), both of which can create/overwrite files. git diff --output=<file> redirects output to arbitrary paths; ripgrep --pre executes arbitrary programs. Contradicts spec.md:49-51, design.md:72, and command docs claiming all pre-approved tools are read-only.

title: candidate.sh report-only assertion misses file modifications
description: git status --porcelain alone doesn't catch: committed changes (tree reads clean), git checkout/reset, writes to .gitignored paths, or writes outside $WD (~/.claude/, /tmp). Future runs that commit or write externally will pass the invariant check falsely.

title: Schema example contradicts rule for confidence field
description: Example object shows 'confidence': 100, but rule at line 36 states finders leave it at 0. Finders copying the example emit 100.

title: Baseline grep pattern too narrow, silently accepts output mismatches
description: Loud-failure cross-check greps only 'found [1-9][0-9]* issue'; patterns like '3 findings', 'Issues found: 3', or refusals pass silently as empty baseline. Systematically misses baseline extraction failures.

title: Prompt injection via untrusted review text in extract and match scripts
description: extract.sh:14 and match.sh:17-19 interpolate untrusted review text; reviso-finder-prior-reviews ingests PR comments. Bounded by read-only tooling but vulnerable if tool restrictions weakened (see finding 1).

title: One concern per PR rule violated: 57 files, ~6 groups in single PR
description: CLAUDE.md states 'one concern per PR' and tasks.md:3 references this rule. Baseline flagged the same issue. Warrants rule amendment or exception note.

title: PR description: unit-tested with mocks claim unsupported
description: PR claims 'Majority + judge logic unit-tested with mocks' but no test files, fixtures, or mock harnesses appear in the 57 changed files.

title: Run provenance not recorded: reuses v0 baseline without tracking
description: No baseline.json in run dir. judge.sh reused v0 baseline but nothing records baseline_ref field for self-description.
